## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Carglow Detailers?
Plot #182, Dandeeswarar Nagar, Ram Nagar South, Madipakkam, Chennai 600 100.

### What facilities does Carglow Detailers have?
Premium car wash, Wash & wax, Engine bay cleaning, Headlight restoration, Interior cleaning, Level 1 polishing, Level 2 paint correction, 9H nano ceramic coating, Graphene coating, Windshield coating, Paint Protection Film, PPF removal, Window tinting, Bike wash & polishing, Detailing, PPF & tint training.

### How long does ceramic coating take?
About 4 days: 2 days of preparation, then 48 hours of curing. Your car is delivered on the 4th day.

### How much is a premium car wash?
₹700 for a small car, ₹750 for a medium car and ₹850 for an SUV, GST extra.

### How do I book Carglow Detailers?
Carglow works by appointment only. Pick a date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 94980 68989.
